title: Video Creator
description:
Synopsis
We are looking for a talented and creative Video Creator to support marketing communication through engaging video content. This role requires proficiency in creating both live-action and animated videos to support branding, lead generation, sales readiness, and customer support initiatives.

What You’ll Do:
- Collaborate with content writers to create video scripts and conceptualize outputs per the marketing brief
- Create marketing videos using stock footage, AI voice-overs, motion graphics, and background music
- Design and deliver animated GIFs for the website
- Ensure consistency in visual style and tone as per the brand guidelines
- Work across different content types like promo videos, product demos, explainer videos, etc.

Expected Outcomes:
- Branding: Animated website GIFs and short videos for social media
- Lead Generation: Promotional videos for product launches and campaigns
- Sales Readiness: Product pitch videos and detailed product demos
- Customer Support: Explainer and tutorial videos

Educational Qualification:
- Must be a graduate with specialization in Design or Video Production
- Must have been educated in English medium throughout
- Passion for Hollywood, world cinema, and animation is a strong plus
- A solid portfolio/showreel of past video work is mandatory

Software Skills:
- Adobe Premiere Pro (Strong command required)
- Adobe After Effects (Strong command required)
- Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop (Basic skills required)

Interview Process:
- Portfolio review (subjective assessment)
- In-person design test (subjective assessment)
- Software skills assessment based on the test

Pre-Interview Requirement (Non-negotiable):
- Must have a portfolio/showreel of previous video work

About GSTHero:
GSTHero is a Perennial initiative to assist Businesses / Tax Consultants / Chartered Accountants in becoming GST-compliant through advanced technology. GSTHero (GSTHero.com) is India’s leading GSP & ASP provider with 10,000+ enterprise clients. Our suite of solutions includes:
1. GST Return Filing Automation
2. e-Invoice Automation
3. ITC Reconciliation
4. e-Way Bill Automation
5. Digital Signing Solutions
6. GST Audit Tool – Third Eye
7. GST APIs for ERP Integration
8. Litigation Management
9. Export-Import Management, and more
We are also expanding globally in response to the global e-invoicing mandates.

About Perennial Systems:
Perennial Systems is an Outsourced Product Development company focused on solving complex engineering and product challenges through structured processes. We work with product-based companies across Southeast Asia, the US, and the UK.
Website: www.perennialsys.com
GSTHero: https://gsthero.com

Please reach out at:
- sayan.mondal@perennialsys.com
- pooja.patil@perennialsys.com

Our Offerings:
- Strong Sales & Marketing Teams: GSTHero's high-performing team is deeply experienced and customer-focused, consistently delivering tailored, results-oriented solutions.
- Consulting Exposure & Product Mindset: Work in a hybrid role that mixes consulting strategy and product thinking for maximum business impact.
- Leadership Exposure: Contribute to key decisions, interact directly with clients, and take ownership of impactful outcomes.
- Domain Expertise: Leverage deep expertise in the GST and broader tax compliance domain, building specialized, enterprise-level solutions.
- Learning Culture: We offer access to over 8000+ courses, sponsor certifications, and organize internal/external tech meetups (via SimplyTech, Perennial's community) to support continuous learning and professional development.

title: Graphic Designer -Intern
description:
Synopsis
We are looking for a talented and creative Graphic Design Intern to support the development of visual
assets in line with our new brand identity. This role involves designing case studies, icons, LinkedIn
posts, and short animated visuals while adhering to established templates and guidelines.

What You’ll Do:
· Help build a bank of collaterals as per the new brand identity
· Design sets of Case Studies based on template
· Design sets of Icons for all websites as per guideline
· Design sets of LinkedIn posts as per template
· Design sets of short animated visuals for all websites
· Must be a student / recent graduate of an arts/design school
· Must have an art/design portfolio
· Must have strong skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and After Effects
· Must be able to read and understand English

Interview process:
· Portfolio review (subjective assessment).
· In-person design test (subjective assessment).
· Software skills assessment based on the test.

About GSTHero:
GST Hero is a Perennial's initiative to assist Businesses / Tax Consultants / Chartered Accountants in
making them compliant with ease through the efficient use of technology. GSTHero (GSTHero.com) is
India's leading GST Suvidha Provider GSP & ASP with 10,000+ enterprise clients across India. GSTHero
offers a fleet of software into GST compliance such as:
1. GST Return Filing automation with cloud tool and integration
2. e-Invoice solution and automation
3. ITC Reconciliation solution and automation
4. e-Way Bill automation
5. Digital Signing Solution
6. GST Audit Tool - Third Eye
7. GST APIs for integration with leading ERPs
8. Litigation Management System
9. Export Import Management and many more to come
GST Hero is expanding globally as an eInvoice mandate has become a global phenomenon.

About Perennial Systems:
Perennial Systems is an Outsourced Product Development Organization with a focus on solving complex
problems of engineering and product teams by following a simple process-driven approach. We specialize
in building products and work with many product-based companies across South East Asia, US & UK.
To know more, please visit our website:
www.perennialsys.com
https://gsthero.com/


Our Offerings:
● Strong sales & marketing teams: GST Hero boasts a formidable sales team that combines
expertise, professionalism, and unwavering dedication to deliver exceptional results. With their
customer-centric approach and extensive industry knowledge, they consistently surpass
expectations and provide tailored solutions to drive success.
● Consulting Exposure & Product Driven Mindset: Our sales team possesses a unique blend of
consulting exposure and a product-driven mindset, enabling them to provide strategic guidance
and customized solutions that align with clients' specific needs and drive business success.
● Leadership Exposure: Our sales partners get an opportunity to take key design decisions,
define sales roadmaps, mentor teammates, engage with clients directly and be accountable for
delivering solutions that adhere to the high standards of Perennial.
● Domain Expertise: We are experts in the Tax domain and have worked widely in the GST Tax
space. Our sales team brings together B2B domain expertise and an in-depth understanding of
the GST product, allowing them to offer comprehensive solutions tailored to the specific
requirements of businesses. Their deep knowledge of both the industry landscape and the
intricacies of the GST system enables them to provide valuable insights and deliver exceptional
value to our clients.
● Learning Culture: GST Hero promotes a learning culture and in no boundaries, we support our
team members to explore & learn the upcoming market trends. Not only this we have a
knowledge base that offers more than 8000+ courses and sponsor certifications, so as to ensure
that our people are learning throughout their span with us. We also arrange for in- house and
external tech MeetUps (SimplyTech, community owned by Perennial Systems) that overall
enhances the growth of our people.
